sourcePlaceholder: Write Markdown, paste a README, or open a .md file…
loadSampleConfirmMessage: Replace the current text with the sample document?
clearConfirmMessage: Clear the current text? For an editing draft, this also removes the saved text from this browser.
outlineEmptyDescription: No Markdown headings. Use #, ##, or ### in the source to add an outline.
previewEmptyDescription: This document is empty. Open a Markdown file, paste text in the editor, or load the sample.
close: Close file and return to draft
releaseFile: Drop a Markdown file to read it
replaceEditedConfirm: Discard edits to this local file? The original file on your device will not change.
openFailed: The browser could not read this file. Try opening it again; it may be unavailable or exceed available memory.
encodingFailed: This file is not readable Markdown text. Save it as UTF-8 or UTF-16 with a byte-order mark and try again.
storageFailed: Browser storage is unavailable or full. You can keep editing, but this draft may not survive a reload.
previewFailed: The browser could not render this document. It may exceed available memory. Retry, edit the source, or open another file.
missingReference: This link does not match a heading or bookmark in this document.
draftSession: Editing draft · saved in this browser
filePrivacy: This local file and any edits stay in memory until you close or reload the page. Your saved editing draft is kept separately and returns when you close the file. The original file is never changed.
draftPrivacy: Text entered in the draft editor is saved in this browser. Opening a local file keeps it separate from your saved draft. Clear text removes the saved draft when no file is open.
supported: Supports standard Markdown and GitHub-style tables, task lists, strikethrough, and fenced code. Code is shown without syntax highlighting. Math, diagrams, footnotes, and other dialect extensions are not rendered.
safePreview: Inline HTML is sanitized. Scripts, forms, embeds, styles, and remote resources are blocked in previews and HTML exports. External links open only when selected. Relative document links are inactive; open those files separately. HTML export and print preserve the rendered content and theme, not reader text size or width.
localImages: Some images refer to local files that were not provided. Their alternative text is shown when available. Relative document links are inactive; open those files separately. Embedded PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP, AVIF, and BMP images are supported.
remoteImages: Remote images were not loaded. Their alternative text is shown when available. This tool does not fetch document images, fonts, or styles from the internet.
